issue.title: Fix Audio Error When Resuming After Pause or Screen Lock
issue.body: When a user pauses an active recording for a few seconds, or locks the screen while a recording is paused, an audio error appears when they try to resume, and the user is prevented from continuing the recording. This blocks translators from completing a take any time they pause briefly or the device locks, forcing them to restart the recording. ## Functional Requirements ### Recording Resume - Resuming a paused recording after a few seconds must not trigger an audio error. - Resuming a paused recording after the screen locks and unlocks must not trigger an audio error. - The user must be able to continue recording into the same take after a pause or screen lock without restarting.

comments.body:
**Test Results:#486 Tested on Pr: #537**

- Recording resumed successfully after a short pause without any audio error.
- Recording resumed successfully after locking and unlocking the screen while paused.
- User was able to continue recording in the same take without restarting.
